name: Tirax
orthography_note: Brotchie's orthography: x velar fricative; v bilabial fricative β (Lynch 2019a: 294, n. 3); t, d, n, l dental, s and r alveolar.
notes: About 800 speakers on the northeast coast of Malakula; traditionally in the mountains of north central Malakula (Brotchie 2009: 1, in Lynch & Brotchie 2010: 379). Lynch & Brotchie state the reflexes from POc (with PNCV forms where these differ); placed under POc with Southern Oceanic as tree parent, as Nese is (decision lynch-parents). The apicolabial shift in Tirax followed low vowel deletion, which no other shifting language has, so they take the shift to be borrowed into Tirax (pp. 371-372, 385).

name: Malua-Tepërav
notes: Language node for the Malua Bay dialect (Glottolog).

name: Malua Bay
notes: Between V'ënen Taut and Nese on the north coast of Malakula; does not show the apicolabial shift. Data from Tryon (1976), via Lynch & Brotchie (2010: 380, Table 3).

name: Vovo
notes: Glottolog files Vovo as a dialect of Nese. Data from Tryon (1976), via Lynch & Brotchie (2010: 380, Table 3): the shift applies to *b and *m in a minority of etyma only, not to *p.

name: Botovro
notes: North Coast Malakula. Data from Tryon (1976), via Lynch & Brotchie (2010: 380, Table 3) and Lynch (2019a: 304, Table 4): mostly linguolabials, with some apicals.

name: Vao
region: Vao Island and the neighbouring north Malakula mainland, Vanuatu
notes: Glottolog's Vao-Vovo; the data are Vao (Tryon 1976, via Lynch & Brotchie 2010: 380, Table 3).
